creative_objective: Stop the scroll with the same legs shown twice in one frame: on the left the 'invisible' problem painted on (a dull grey veil over thin legs in baggy jeans), on the right the result (fuller, toned legs and wider hips in leggings with warm golden lines of energy). The headline reframes the cause: curves start with appetite.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the grey-veiled thin legs against the golden glowing fuller legs, 2) the headline, 3) the segment line, 4) the yellow button and the 'Pagas al recibir' badge, 5) the bottle
art_direction.composition_style: Full-bleed split screen divided by a thin white vertical line, a curved yellow arrow crossing the line at mid-height, text block over the lower-left, bottle in the lower-right over the after legs
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Photos fill the whole canvas; the lower 35 % holds the text on the left 55 % over a soft dark fade so it reads; the bottle stands in the lower-right corner
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft studio key light from the upper left, gentle shadows, the golden lines glow softly on the skin of the after side only
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: The reference image shows, on an intense solid color background, a canvas split in two by a thin white vertical line: left half the same body from the waist to the feet, front view, with the problem painted on the skin as thick blobs; right half the same body clean with thin golden glowing lines running down the legs. A curved yellow arrow points from left to right at mid-height. Lower-left 55 %: a huge two-line headline (first line white, second line yellow and taller), a two-line subtitle in white caps with the segment highlighted in yellow, a thin yellow swoosh line and a wide yellow pill button with dark text. Lower-right: one dropper bottle standing over the after legs. No logo, no price, no offer. Our version keeps this exact scene and order, changes the background to lemon yellow, the body zone to legs and hips in jeans/leggings, and adds a small bordered 'Pagas al recibir' badge under the button.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 photographic image ad. BACKGROUND: solid lemon-yellow (#F5E13A) studio backdrop with a soft darker vignette at the corners, split exactly in half by a thin 6 px white vertical line from top to about 70 % of the height. TOP AND CENTER (0 % to 68 % of the canvas), LEFT HALF = BEFORE: ultra-realistic photo, front view, camera at hip height, 50 mm lens, framed from just under the bust to the ankles, of an adult Colombian woman about 25 years old with warm light-brown skin with real pores and fine texture, wearing a fitted white cotton crop t-shirt with small wrinkles and light-wash blue jeans one size too big: the jeans hang loose on her thighs with vertical folds, the hips are straight and almost as narrow as her waist, her thighs are thin and straight with a visible gap, and her right hand pulls the front waistband about a fist away from her belly so the empty space inside the jeans is clearly visible. Over her thighs and hips floats a dull, semi-transparent grey haze, like a cold veil with tiny grey dust particles, that makes that side look tired and switched off; her skin under it is slightly desaturated. LEFT AND RIGHT ARE THE SAME WOMAN. RIGHT HALF = AFTER, another day: same woman, same front view and framing, now in a fitted plain black cotton t-shirt and matte black high-waisted leggings; her hips are clearly wider than her waist, her thighs are fuller, rounder and toned, filling the leggings with a smooth curved outline, standing relaxed and confident, hands resting at her sides. Thin warm golden lines of light (#F5E13A to #C9962B) run down the front of each thigh and along the curve of the hips with a few soft glowing dots, like gentle energy, subtle and elegant, not medical, no veins, no anatomy. A thick curved lemon-yellow arrow with a soft shadow crosses the white divider at mid-height pointing from the left half to the right half. Soft studio key light from the upper left, gentle natural shadows, fabric texture visible on denim and leggings. BOTTOM 35 %: a soft deep-cocoa (#2B1A10) gradient rises from the bottom edge to about 35 % of the height so the text reads. LOWER-LEFT 55 % of the width, stacked and left-aligned: line 1 of the headline in Poppins ExtraBold uppercase, white #FFFFFF, very large; line 2 in Poppins ExtraBold uppercase, lemon yellow #F5E13A, even taller, with a slight top-to-bottom yellow-to-gold gradient; under it a two-line subtitle in Poppins SemiBold uppercase white with the segment words in lemon yellow; a thin curved yellow swoosh line; then a wide rounded pill button in solid lemon yellow with the button text in Poppins ExtraBold deep cocoa; directly below the button a small rounded badge with a 2 px white border and a cocoa fill with a tiny hand-and-box icon and the trust text in white Poppins SemiBold. LOWER-RIGHT CORNER, standing in front of the after legs, the product bottle at about 34 % of the canvas height, upright, label facing the camera and fully legible, with a soft contact shadow. PRODUCT: use the attached product photo as the only source of truth: ONE amber-brown glass dropper bottle about 2.6 times taller than wide, Boston-round body with rounded shoulders, ribbed matte black collar about 55 % of the body width, tall matte black rubber dropper bulb, wrap-around label lemon-yellow fading to white with 'amua', the big white outlined word 'VITALDROPS', 'All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', five small outlined ingredient circles (A, MA, L, F, BR) and 'Dietary Supplement 2 fl. oz. (60mL)'. Not a slim bottle, not a squat jar, label never mirrored, matte, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare, no yellow '60ml' circle. Natural realistic people, not plastic skin, no studio make-up.
